types.name: Tabs
types.text: The kinds of skill the character knows. Level Up lists the skills that can be learned now.

search.name: Search and sort
search.text: Filters the list by name and changes its order.

grid.name: Skills
grid.text: Every skill in the open tab. Pick one to see its card on the right page.

loadout.name: Loadout
loadout.text: The nine skills usable in battle. Best and Random fill it for you.

sync.name: Sync and Desync
sync.text: Sync puts the selected skill in the loadout, Desync takes it out. Some skills are always synced and use no slot.

card.name: Skill card
card.text: Cost, element, damage and effects of the selected skill, and Use to cast it outside battle.

list.text: This character's synced skills. Pick one to cast it.

cost.name: Cost
cost.text: The MP or AP a skill spends. A skill the character cannot afford is dimmed.

weapon.name: Weapon needs
weapon.text: A skill marked Needs melee or Needs ranged works only with that kind of weapon in hand.

target.name: Target
target.text: Ally skills ask for a target after you pick them.

help.text: Opens this sheet. On a controller, press Select; press it again, Back or Confirm to close.

special.mcLoop: Makes the foe repeat its last action for 1 to 3 turns
special.mcRebound: Throws the next enemy skill back at its caster
special.mcPuppet: The user picks the foe's next move, aimed at its own side
special.mcTurncoat: Turns the foe's next action on its own side
special.mcEcho: The user's next skill fires twice, the second time free
special.mcMindRead: Reveals the foe's next action and holds it to it

reaction.Electrocute: Paralyses a Wet foe and dries it
reaction.FlashFreeze: May freeze a Wet foe solid
reaction.Ignite: Sets an Oily foe Burned, leaping to oily neighbours
reaction.Shatter: Shatters a Frozen or Brittle foe for 50 to 60% more damage
reaction.Thaw: Thaws a Frozen foe to Wet and melts a Brittle foe's rime
reaction.Steam: Turns a Hot foe's aura to blinding steam
reaction.Fanned: Fans a Burned foe's flames onto its neighbours
reaction.Fumes: Boils a Poisoned foe's venom into Nausea fumes
reaction.Detonate: Detonates a Volatile foe for double damage
reaction.Spark: Sparks a Volatile foe for 50% more damage

special.lifeLinkAllies: Links the party: HP damage is shared evenly
special.lifeLinkFoes: Links the foes: a blow on one spreads to the rest
special.guardianSelf: The user takes half of each ally's HP damage
special.guardian: Takes half of each ally's HP damage
special.buildsStackOnKill: Each foe it fells adds 1 to {stack} (max {max})
special.aimedAimable: Choose the body part to strike with Aim
special.expireDamage: {state} comes due after {turns} turns and strikes the holder
special.expireDamageArea: {state} detonates after {turns} turns: hits the holder and all its allies
special.expireHeal: {state} heals the holder when it ends, after {turns} turns
special.expireSkill: {state} casts {skill} on the holder when it ends, after {turns} turns
special.expireSkillArea: {state} casts {skill} on the holder's whole side when it ends, after {turns} turns
special.ammoAll: Empties the magazine: one hit per round spent
special.ammoReload: Reloads the magazine; not with it full
special.ammoWhip: Free when the magazine is empty
special.bulletHell: Cast by a foe: starts a dodge phase, damage scales with hits taken
special.psiDodge: Starts a dodge phase flown by the user
special.shrinksHitbox: Shrinks the craft in a dodge phase
special.selfStateChance: {chance}% chance to put {state} on the user
special.drainRate: Heals the user for {pct}% of the damage
special.drainMp: Steals MP worth {pct}% of the damage
special.bonusWhileWounded: Stronger the more the user is wounded
special.usesTargetPower: Turns the target's own power against it
special.taunt: Taunts the foe into attacking the user
